named_control_calibration_for_child.condition: Apply in the new child only if frozen HOME PM due h9, failed P-MECH availability at h9, open wait through the entire [9,9.5) bin, and same typed source-fixed wait state are independently established before looking at the report. numeric_bounds.propagation: Derive each expected cell from source constants and typed event state intervals. Combine algebraically cancelling edges first. B_time=sum(abs(c_j)*u(t_j))/D for signed state-jump coefficients c_j and the named denominator. Add B_serial=5e-7 only for genuinely computed nonexact fractional serialization. Never choose an edge, class, coefficient, tolerance or denominator from the candidate report. If an edge is unknown or B_time+B_serial exceeds its class ceiling, NO_GO.
numeric_bounds.time_print_uncertainty: For each genuinely printed, non-source-exact event edge t with d digits after the decimal, u(t)=0.5*10**(-d) hours. Source-scheduled opening h0, mission h8 and HOME PM h9 get u=0 only when their typed source/event linkage proves exactness; an integer-looking log string alone is insufficient.
